item.title: RKLB Stock: The Surprising Truth Behind a 49% Plunge
item.description:
Here’s a fact that stops most investors cold: RKLB stock rocketed more than 600% higher in a single year — then gave back nearly half of it in a matter of weeks.

So which story is real? The unstoppable SpaceX challenger, or an overpriced rocket maker crashing back to Earth?

The truth, as usual, lives somewhere in the middle. And the numbers behind Rocket Lab tell a far more interesting tale than the headlines suggest.

item.title: Rocket Launch Today: Your Essential Guide to Liftoffs
item.description:
Did you know there are three rocket launches scheduled in a single day? If you searched “rocket launch today,” you landed at the right place—the skies above Florida, California, and New Zealand are busier than ever.

Quick Summary: Multiple orbital launches are happening right now. SpaceX is flying a massive SiriusXM satellite from Cape Canaveral, Rocket Lab is sending up a Japanese radar satellite, and a Starlink batch already reached orbit. Here’s everything you need to track the action—and why it matters.
